description: This file defines an ImageProcessor class that processes and analyzes medical images using OpenAI's GPT-4V model. It includes methods for reading image files, encoding them, and generating detailed medical analysis reports via API calls.

classes.name: ImageProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing and analyzing medical images using GPT-4V.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ImageProcessor with an OpenAI API client.

methods.name: analyze_image
methods.description: Asynchronously analyzes a medical image at a given path, optionally with contextual information, and returns a detailed analysis.
